symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows payment-service receiving HTTP 429 TooManyRequests from gateway-mock on POST /authorize: 6 client and server rejections versus 0 previously, with 6 FAILED payments and 6 PAYMENT_FAILED orders, while 5 authorizations succeed. gateway-mock shows no errors or restarts and healthy latency, and the gateway answers quickly, so it rejects by rate limiting; the failure starts at gateway-mock. Order and inventory services are healthy. Category is DEPENDENCY_REJECTING.

evidence.why: gateway-mock server side returns 429 CLIENT_ERROR TooManyRequests: 0 previous, 6 incident
payment-service client side gets 429 TooManyRequests from gateway-mock, 6 in incident
payments FAILED count rose from 0 to 6 in incident window
gateway-mock health and latency are fast and steady, so it is up and answering
gateway-mock has no WARN or ERROR logs, consistent with a deliberate rate-limit answer
